The destination Team's name (Rails `runes/show.rb:79-82` prints it next to the invitation;
`null` for a signup-only invitation).

data.description:
The answer of a mass unassignment: the invitation with its capacity restored and how many
redemptions were removed (Rails' redirect notice carries the same count,
`rune_mass_unassignable.rb:20`).

authorizing_api_key_id.description: Authenticated API key that created this Spec; absent for human imports.

env_pack_attachments.description: Ordered Spec-level ENV pack attachments (job-mode Specs only).

locked.description: A referencing Playground prevents deletion while authoring stays available.

source_template_version.description: Source lineage retained by the public Rails Spec representation.

suggested_template_version.description: Newest readable newer version of the origin template, for switch selection.

id.description: Positive: blob effect. Negative: source deletion for copy effect -id.

redirect_url.description: Provider navigation URL. It carries no client secret or token.

consecutive_probe_failures.description: Recorded failure streak; success resets it, and a 30-minute gap expires it.

docker_availability.description:
Docker health: unknown until success or five consecutive failed probes.
One successful Docker observation recovers immediately.

ssh_fingerprint_display.description: OpenSSH `ssh-keygen -lf` display, including bits, comment and algorithm.

oneOf.description:
Safe projection of a Playground source-index retry; raw payload values
remain hidden from the operator ledger.

payload_fields.description:
Payload field names only; raw values may contain identifiers or
capabilities and remain undisclosed by the ledger view.

oneOf.description: Latest chat startup attempt; queued admission is not completed deployment.
Non-secret initiating launch authority, exposed on owner detail reads.

build_warnings.description:
Rails `build_warnings` (lifecycle.rb:282-295): the stored string-keyed string
entries as they are; cleared only inside lifecycle transitions.

dirty_services.description: Services with changes in the last observed applied-generation checkout.

oneOf.description: Policy-gated typed diagnostics; raw output and credentials are omitted.

error_message.description: Fixed safe message for the current stored failure.

git_dirty_services.description: Published Git dirty flag of each Repository-backed service.

playguard_repair_reason.description: Reasons of the Playguard recovery that queued the active operation.

service_overrides.description: Sparse stored overrides. Secret ENV values are omitted.

services.description: Effective Spec services with sparse Playground overrides applied.

source_verification_path.description:
Applied checkout path, relative to the workload root, that failed
verification when its Host was last prepared.

service_env.description: Per-service winning values and provenance. Private inputs are redacted.

error_message.description:
Explanation for target validation failures and a diff that produced no
result; for a definite remote push rejection, Git's own error text as Rails
returns it (remote_git_commit_service.rb:30-31), or "push rejected" for a
request settled before that text was recorded.

generated_compose.description: Redacted augmented desired document; not proof of deployment.

limits.description: Effective limit per quota key (the retained `limits` metadata map).

only returned by the sudo-gated reveal route.

A failed sync's user-facing reason (Rails GitManager's renewal text for
`github_authorization_required`), built only from the result code and
the Repository URL; absent unless the sync failed.

storage.description: Blob storage inventory: observed objects and quarantined unknown ones.

allow_insecure_http.description: Accepted and stored for earlier clients; it decides nothing (see `allow_private_network`).

allow_private_network.description:
Accepted and stored for earlier clients; it decides nothing. Rails has no per-endpoint
consent: the destination rules are the deployment class and the
`policy.enforce_webhook_https` / `policy.enforce_webhook_ssrf` settings.
